faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Does it change my original textures?
faq.a1: No. Saving always creates a new PNG with _ats added to the name. Your original files are never overwritten.
faq.qai: Can an AI app help me with it?
faq.aai: Optionally. With MCP for Unity (a separate free package), an AI app can recolour and add layers while you watch. It starts off, saving and pictures wait for your Allow, and the README has the steps and notes.
faq.q2: Is anything uploaded with my avatar?
faq.a2: No. It is an editor-only package, so none of it is included in your avatar or VRChat upload.
faq.a3: Quick recolour works with Poiyomi and lilToon materials. Selecting and painting work on any texture, whatever the shader. Quick material controls also need Poiyomi or lilToon.
faq.q4: What do I need to run it?
faq.a4: Unity 2022.3, the version VRChat uses. It needs no other packages; Poiyomi and lilToon unlock extra features if you have them installed.
faq.q5: How do I update or remove it?
faq.a5: Update with the same method you installed with: in VCC pick the new version under Manage Project, or import the newer Unity package. To remove it, press − in VCC or delete Packages/com.avistry.toolkit.
faq.q6: I found a bug or have an idea
faq.a6: Please open an issue on GitHub. A screenshot or the Unity Console message helps a lot.
faq.q7: Can I use it on a bought avatar?
faq.a7: Yes. Avistry saves new files next to the ones you bought, so the originals stay as they came. Check the avatar's terms before you share edited textures.
trust.r5.data: No telemetry. The only network call is an optional update check that asks GitHub for the latest version number, and it is off until you turn it on.
faq.a8: No. Avistry has no telemetry. Its only network call is an optional update check, off until you turn it on, that asks GitHub for the latest version number and sends nothing about you or your project. The optional AI helper is separate: it works through your own AI app, which sends part and material names to its service, and pictures only after you click Allow.

ab.meta.description: What Avistry is and is not, how to check a download yourself, answers to common questions and how to help.
ab.title: Safety, FAQ, and how to help.
ab.what: What Avistry is, and is not.
ab.f1: It lives in the Unity Editor. Nothing goes into your upload.
ab.f2.b: No script, component or assembly is added to your avatar. Saving makes new files and never overwrites yours.
ab.made.p: Avistry is built with the help of an AI assistant. The maintainers read and review the code, test every feature in a real Unity Editor and fix what breaks. This catches a lot, but it is not a guarantee. If you find a problem, please open an issue.
ab.help.2.b: Pull requests are welcome. The maintainers review every one and test it in Unity.
ab.vision.title: Why Avistry exists
ab.vision.p: A free, open-source toolkit for VRChat avatars: recolour, paint and fix your avatar inside Unity, in plain words.
ab.vision.1.b: It never overwrites your originals, lives only in the Unity Editor and sends no data. These are rules in the code, not settings.
ab.vision.4.b: New ideas are discussed on Discord first. Contributions, often built with AI agents, are reviewed and tested in Unity by the maintainers before they ship.
